description: Senator Wendy Rogers has earned the endorsement of the Arizona State Troopers Association (AZSTA) for her re-election campaign, adding another respected law enforcement organization to her growing coalition of support. title: Arizona State Troopers Association Endorses Sen. Wendy Rogers for Re-Election | Wendy Rogers
